items: Classes & Objects: A class defines state and behaviour; objects are instances of that definition.
Functions: Reusable blocks of code that take arguments and return values.
Interfaces: A pure contract of method signatures with no implementation.
Static & Constants: Members belonging to the class itself rather than to any one instance.
Traits: A bundle of methods mixed into classes to share behaviour horizontally.
Abstract Classes: A partial base class that forces subclasses to complete certain methods.
Arrow Functions: fn() => expressions: closures with automatic by-value capture.

8225.title: Combining Traits and Interfaces
8225.code:
<?php
class ShopProduct implements IdentityObject
{
    use PriceUtilities;
    use IdentityTrait;
}
8225.explanation: If I want ShopProduct to fulfill the IdentityObject type, I must now make it implement the IdentityObject interface.
